Definition: Kadmonite (collectively), the name of a tribe in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: The Kadmonites are named among the peoples whose land God promised to Abram. The Kenites, the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites stand at the head of the list of ten nations.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the promise was wider than Abram could see, and the Kadmonites are part of the land God had already marked out for His people.
